knowledge_entries.title: USB Controller IC (Tristar/Hydra/Tigris) Diagnostic Standard
knowledge_entries.summary: Non-MFi knockoff car chargers generate voltage spikes that blow the primary 5V clamp diode inside Hydra/Tristar IC, resulting in 1% battery freeze or high standby leakage.
critical_checks: Test current draw with USB Power Meter; 0.00A or cycling 0.04A - 0.24A indicates damaged Hydra IC
Measure diode mode on Tristar test points (PP_VBUS2_PIN1, USB_PROT_DP/DN)
Always replace with correct IC revision (1610A1/A2/A3 or 1612A1) and use 0.02mm insulated jumper if solder pad delaminates

knowledge_entries.title: Main FPC Interconnect Flex Solder Joint Separation
knowledge_entries.summary: Drop impacts on Galaxy A-series and S-series frequently crack the surface solder joints on the mainboard-side 78-pin FPC charging connector, causing 'moisture detected in charging port' or slow charge warnings even when port is completely dry.
critical_checks: Under microscope, push gently on FPC connector pins with needle probe to check for loose solder joints
Reflow connector with micro-soldering pencil and leaded solder at 320°C before replacing entire motherboard
Verify 5.0V VBUS reaches upper mainboard charging IC

knowledge_entries.title: Electro-Chemical Corrosion Neutralization & Safe Power Up Protocol
knowledge_entries.summary: Applying power to a wet motherboard initiates galvanic corrosion that destroys copper traces within seconds. Immediate desoldering of shields, ultrasonic IPA bath, and heat-cured dehydration are mandatory prior to any power injection.
critical_checks: Never attempt to power on with charger before full ultrasonic cleaning and dehydrating bake
Check diode readings on all major buck-regulator coils to identify shorted bypass capacitors
Coat repaired board areas with conformal UV mask to seal bare copper

knowledge_entries.title: Lithium-Ion Pouch Puncture & Thermal Runaway Mitigation
knowledge_entries.summary: Damaged or bloated lithium-ion cells can enter self-sustaining exothermic thermal runaway (> 500°C within 15 seconds) if punctured with metal tools or heated over 80°C.
critical_checks: Never use metal tweezers, blades, or sharp pry tools directly under battery pouch
Use 99% IPA around battery perimeter to dissolve adhesive bonds without excessive mechanical pulling
Keep Class D fire extinguishing sand container within 2 meters of the disassembly workbench
